page_title: OSA 1-1 PAL | Osasuna v Las Palmas 11/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+6' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
90+4' A precise cross towards the penalty spot was latched onto by Raul (Osasuna). He outjumped the defence and produced a decent header which went a whisker wide of the left post.
90+2' The resulting set piece from Osasuna is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+2' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Osasuna, is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Osasuna.
90' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.
90' 22:8 – this is the current number of fouls committed by both teams.
88' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna) replacing Aimar Oroz.
88' Substitution. Raul (Osasuna) replaces Ante Budimir.
87' The foul by Julian Araujo (Las Palmas) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Jorge Figueroa Vazquez.
86' Las Palmas take a short corner kick.
84' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
82' The corner evades everyone in the centre and ends up at the back post where Saul Coco (Las Palmas) sends a wild header high over the bar.
82' Enzo Loiodice (Las Palmas) prepares to take a corner kick.
81' Substitution. Chimy Avila makes his way off the pitch and Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna) comes on as his replacement.
80' The attendance is 20125.
77' Kike Barja (Osasuna) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.

73' 1 - 1 It's a goal! Ante Budimir (Osasuna) makes it 1:1. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Jon Moncayola and planted his close-range header into the left side of the goal. Alvaro Valles was helpless.
73' Here comes a substitution. Marvin is given a rest as he is replaced by Julian Araujo (Las Palmas).
73' Substitution. Marc Cardona (Las Palmas) on for Munir El Haddadi.
70' 0 - 1 What a beauty from just outside the box! Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) lashed the ball with incredible pace and power into the top right corner.
67' Jagoba Arrasate prepares a substitution. Moi Gomez is replaced by Jon Moncayola (Osasuna).
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Kike Barja (Osasuna) replaces Ruben Pena.

67' The corner is slung over and David Garcia (Osasuna) out jumps the defence inside the six-yard box, but the header skims off the top of his head and goes miles wide of the right post for a goal kick.
67' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Osasuna will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
66' The corner is swung in but Osasuna can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
65' Osasuna can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
61' Marvin (Las Palmas) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.
58' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to substitute Sory Kaba and he is replaced by Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas).
58' The game has come to an end for Maximo Perrone. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Enzo Loiodice (Las Palmas).
57' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
54' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Las Palmas out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
52' Alvaro Valles pulls off a great save to block a header from Ante Budimir (Osasuna) after a nice lofted cross.
49' Chimy Avila (Osasuna) heads the ball towards goal, but his effort is saved by the goalkeeper.
48' Osasuna earn a corner.
48' Chimy Avila (Osasuna) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. Now Osasuna have a corner.
48' Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
46' Ruben Pena (Osasuna) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Las Palmas, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
44' Ruben Pena (Osasuna) feels very aggrieved after the referee stops play for a foul that he commits while heading towards goal with the ball.
41' Las Palmas players are playing combination football and attempting to create a goal-scoring opportunity, but they will have to wait for that as they have just lost possession due to a poor pass.
39' None of the Osasuna players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
38' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) meets a splendid cross on the edge of the 6-yard box and sends the ball towards the left post, forcing Alvaro Valles into a superb diving save to keep it out.
36' A pass into the penalty area from Johan Mojica (Osasuna) is intercepted by the defence.
34' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) sets himself up on the edge of the box, but balloons his shot way over the bar.
33' Las Palmas are awarded a free kick from mid-range. The position is unsuitable for a direct shot, so expect a cross into the box.
30' Osasuna quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
29' Moi Gomez (Osasuna) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away. Osasuna force their opponents to concede a corner.
28' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
26' Las Palmas take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
24' The ball is out of play. Osasuna will have a throw-in.
22' Sergi Cardona (Las Palmas) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
22' The game is interrupted now, Sergi Cardona (Las Palmas) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
18' The whipped in corner perfectly picks out Ante Budimir (Osasuna) near the penalty spot, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes a mile over the bar.
18' It's going to be a corner kick.
17' Moi Gomez (Osasuna) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
14' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) controls a cross inside the six-yard box, but sends his shot slightly wide of the left post.
13' Chimy Avila (Osasuna) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
11' Osasuna are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
8' The ball is cleared after Marvin (Las Palmas) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
6' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Osasuna was in an offside position.
5' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
3' A pass from Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) is intercepted by Sergio Herrera and the move breaks down.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Las Palmas will have the kick-off.
Jorge Figueroa Vazquez will officiate today.
